name: Spatial Split Carousel
description: Full-height image carousel that cuts each slide into vertical slices which slide away and reveal the next image in a staggered wave, with a counter, progress bars and animated titles.
contents: Full-bleed image slides with title and meta line
Top label with pulsing dot and slide counter
Progress bar indicators and Prev / Next buttons
behavior: Autoplays and advances after the autoplay interval
Slices of the outgoing image slide up and down alternately while the new image reveals with a staggered delay
Active progress bar fills over the autoplay duration
Clicking a progress bar or Prev / Next jumps to that slide
editableByProps: Slides, titles, meta text and images
Label, button labels, accent and background colors
Slice count, autoplay speed, width and height

needsCodeEdit.change: Change slice transition direction or easing
needsCodeEdit.where: translationDirection constant and the cubic-bezier values in the slice style
textUp keyframes in the style block

fixed: Slide change lock lasts 1100ms, matching the slice animation timing
